06FAQs

Common questions

Can't find yours? Call +971 4 550 6700 or email sme@beehive.ae.

Which product is right for my business?
If you need to cover costs while B2B customers pay, Working Capital Finance is built for that. For a longer-term plan such as expansion or equipment, Term Finance fits better.
Is the rate an interest rate?
No. It's the percentage used to calculate the customer's share of profit from the Sharia-compliant transaction. Beehive is certified by the Shariya Review Bureau.
What fees apply?
Both products carry a one-time 3.5% processing fee. Term Finance has no early repayment charges. With Working Capital Finance you only pay for the days you use.
How quickly can I be funded?
Term Finance: credit approval takes 3–4 days once all your documents are in, with funds paid within 48 hours of approval. Working Capital: your limit is typically approved within 10 business days, then each invoice is funded within 48 hours of approval.
How does drawing against invoices work?
Once your limit is approved, you submit B2B invoices as you need funding. Each invoice is discounted the same day and you repay over 90 to 120 days.
Do I need to provide security?
Term Finance is unsecured. Working Capital Finance needs no cash margin and has no assignment requirement.
Is Beehive regulated?
Yes. Beehive P2P Limited is regulated by the Dubai Financial Services Authority (licence F004422) and is an e& enterprise company.
